title: Intef the Elder
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 15 (Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL)).
description: Ruler of Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 15, "EKL Solution Dynasties 4, 11, 12, 6"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: 1917; End: 1887). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 15 "EKL Solution Dynasties 4, 11, 12, 6", p. 103
reign.note: Row "EKL #8 Gosormies = Inteff the Elder" of Table 15 (Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL)).
